note: Written by hand on 2026-10-29 (lane Nube-3) to exercise tinytms.adapters.voice_from_transcript. Not ASR output, not a person's voice. 'meant' is what the speaker meant (null: the speaker did not say one clear value); 'expect' is what the parser must return. 'expect' is either 'meant' or null, never another value. 'detail' is a substring the witness detail must carry when the count is null. 'seal_detail' is a substring the witness detail must carry when the seal is null; a null seal on a transcript that names a seal always says why. The 'n8' cases were added on 2026-11-02 (ORDER Nube-8), one group per numbered fix. ORDER Nube-9 (2026-11-03) changed what some of them expect, never to another value: an id said after words other than a lead-in, a hedged seal, and seal digits said in groups of different sizes are now null with the reason.
